narr: A cold front passed through the area during the afternoon of the 14th into the evening and overnight hours. Ahead of the cold front, there was plenty of instability and moisture, so thunderstorms produced heavy rainfall. This led to instances of flooding and flash flooding.
ev: The Accotink Creek at Strathmeade Springs rapidly passed minor flood stage, cresting at 254.08 feet at 1:00 AM EST. The water level fell below flood stage at 2:41 AM EST. |Both Woodburn Road and Prosperity Avenue were flooded by at least six inches of water.

The stream at Difficult Run surpassed minor flood stage, cresting at 195.74 feet at 3:50 AM EST. The water level fell below flood stage at 5:47 AM EST. Six inches of water covered the area around its lowest point.
lsr: ACCOTINK CREEK AT STRATHMEADE SPRINGS REACHED MINOR FLOODING STAGE.
DIFFICULT RUN STREAM GAUGE REACHED MINOR FLOOD STAGE.
